note:
FEATURE / WORLDBUILDER ISSUE: Extend VoxelShowcase with a large mountain that acts as a major visible landmark, with a continuous winding path that starts from accessible showcase terrain and climbs to a usable summit. The player must be able to follow the path from the base to the top without requiring jumps, teleportation, or traversal through impassable terrain.

At the summit, place a placeholder dragon. For now the dragon may be represented by a clearly visible large cube; the important requirement is the gameplay/worldbuilding capability and placement at the destination, not final dragon art.

When the player approaches the dragon, proximity must initiate a cutscene/dialogue sequence. The minimal acceptable cutscene may simply present the exact dialogue: "Hello, I'm Mr. Dragon." It must be triggered by approaching the dragon in the built VoxelShowcase, not by a debug key or test-only hook. The trigger should use a reusable/configurable proximity or interaction mechanism rather than a scene-specific distance check.

ARCHITECTURE BOUNDARY: The mountain, winding path, summit destination, dragon placeholder placement/spawn, proximity trigger, and cutscene/dialogue composition must all be expressed through the standard WorldBuilder API and reusable voxel-engine/game modules. VoxelShowcase scene code may choose parameters, placement intent, dimensions, seeds, trigger radius, dialogue content, and composition order, but it must not implement bespoke mountain/path generation, direct voxel-writing, procedural mesh generation, dragon-specific proximity polling, or cutscene/UI behavior locally. Do not solve this by hand-authoring the mountain/path/dragon directly into the .unity scene hierarchy.

If WorldBuilder or the shared engine/game modules cannot currently express any required capability, add/generalize that capability in the reusable engine/game layer and expose it through WorldBuilder, then compose it from VoxelShowcase. Do not add one-off helpers whose semantics are tied only to this scene, this mountain, or Mr. Dragon. Prefer reusable concepts such as authored terrain landmarks, traversable path carving/placement, summit/POI placement, entity/placeholder spawning, proximity triggers, and cutscene/dialogue actions.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) built VoxelShowcase contains a visually substantial mountain with a clearly readable winding ascent; (2) the player can traverse the path from its base to the summit; (3) a large cube placeholder dragon is present at the summit and is stably grounded/placed; (4) approaching it through normal gameplay initiates the cutscene/dialogue and presents "Hello, I'm Mr. Dragon."; (5) the new world and gameplay behavior is composed through WorldBuilder/shared reusable modules with no scene-local generation or interaction implementation; (6) any missing reusable capability is added to the engine/shared game layer rather than directly to VoxelShowcase; (7) focused behavioral regressions exercise the production WorldBuilder path for mountain/path composition, dragon placement, and proximity-to-cutscene behavior; and (8) the exact built-application VoxelShowcase harness reaches a usable rendered scene without startup/runtime exceptions and verifies the approach-to-dragon flow. Check blast radius and runtime/world-build cost for any new shared primitive.
resolutionSummary: Added reusable WorldBuilder mountain/path/placeholder composition and semantic site-proximity story dispatch, including an explicit final switchback landing. VoxelShowcase now composes the summit dragon greeting through shared WorldBuilder, Story, Campaign, and Cutscene systems. Exact-SHA targeted CI and the real-player VoxelShowcase scene harness passed for source 0168881859b560e75033e993809480f512916fae.
